plans.idea: Centered top-to-bottom story: the logo caps the page, a full-width headline and subheadline lead, then the glow and the bottle sit side by side as one product row, and a centered Shop Now button closes it.
Image-first, left-aligned grid: the glow fills the top left with the bottle beside it, the copy and a left-aligned CTA follow on one shared left edge, and the logo signs off at the bottom left.

Brand mark on top, then a large centered glow as the mood image, then the full-width copy, and a closing action row where the Shop Now button sits next to the bottle so the product and the purchase are grouped together.
